D: A cocky ex-soldier learns flair bartending from an old pro in New York, then pours drinks on a Jamaican beach and falls for an artist.
P: Pour the drinks when the barman poet recites his poem.
S: Chicken thighs in fiery jerk spice, grilled on skewers, lime to squeeze.

Mix the jerk paste, half the lime juice, sugar and oil and coat the chicken. Thread onto the skewers. Grill over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through. Squeeze over the rest of the lime and scatter with chilli and spring onion.
700g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks@Meat
Coconut shrimp with mango chilli dip
Coconut shrimp with a mango chilli dip, a beach bar favorite.

Blitz the mango with the sweet chilli and lime for the dip. Coat the prawns in flour, egg, then the coconut and panko mixed together. Shallow-fry in batches at 180C until golden. Drain and serve hot with the dip.
16 large green prawns, peeled with tails on@Seafood
M: Escovitch snapper for the Bonnie bet
Fried snapper under pickled vegetables. Doug makes a bet.

Simmer the vinegar, sugar, allspice and peppercorns, pour over the onion, carrot, capsicum and chilli and leave to pickle. Season the fish, dust with flour and fry skin-side down in the oil until crisp, then flip. Lay the fish on a platter and spoon the hot pickle over the top. Leave for a few minutes before serving so the fish soaks it up.
Slow-cooked curry goat with rice. Doug turns up married to Kerry.

Rub the goat with the curry powder, onion, garlic, ginger and thyme and leave for 20 minutes. Brown the goat in the oil, then cover with water, add the whole chilli and simmer gently, covered, until tender. Add the potatoes for the last 25 minutes so they thicken the sauce. Cook the rice with the coconut milk, beans, 300ml water and salt until fluffy, and serve with the curry.
1.2kg goat shoulder on the bone, cut in chunks@Meat
W: Grilled pineapple in cinnamon sugar. Flanagan's Cocktails and Dreams opens.
Brush the pineapple with the butter and press into the sugar and cinnamon. Grill on a hot pan until caramelised on both sides. Serve warm with coconut ice cream, lime zest and toasted coconut.
1 ripe pineapple, peeled and cut in thick rings@Produce
K: The barman poet's Sex on the Beach
Vodka, peach schnapps and orange shaken hard. Brian, the world's last barman poet.
Shake the vodka, schnapps and orange juice hard with ice. Strain into 4 tall glasses of ice. Pour the cranberry juice slowly over the top so it sits in a layer, and add an orange wheel.
